root_cause: compile_editor.ps1 returns success=true even when compile errors exist

bug_chain.description: compileSuccess is overridden to true when nt8-compile.ps1 exit code is 0, regardless of whether compile errors exist. The exit code reflects script execution success, not compilation success.

compile_editor does not include path_used in its return JSON. fix_loop.ps1 checks path_used != 'devaddon' to decide whether to run a verification compile. Missing path_used (null) always triggers the extra verification compile, adding ~70s of unnecessary delay.
bug_chain.fix: Add path_used = 'editor' to the result hashtable

bug_chain.description: fix_loop trusts compileJson.success without cross-checking error_count. When compile_editor falsely reports success=true with error_count=1, fix_loop skips the entire error-parse → fix-route → apply cycle and exits as SUCCESS.

individual_step_results.compile_headless: INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE — no paths (no DevAddon, no NinjaScript.exe, no MSBuild)
individual_step_results.compile_editor: Returned success=true, error_count=1, errors=[CS0246 FakeNamespace line 22], elapsed_ms=70754

verdict: FAIL — fix loop has a false-positive bug that prevents it from entering the fix cycle when compile_editor is the only available compile path
